_comment: The village guard. An iron golem already has combat AI and a target, so unlike the villagers it can actually use attack spells.

spells._comment: stomp is a forward ground AoE that lands in front of the caster, not at the target - keep max_range short and safety_radius wide, or the AoE falls short.

conditions._comment: difficulties accepts peaceful, easy, normal and hard. Listing all four keeps the golem useful on a peaceful world - though the peacefulDisablesCasting config option can still switch casting off there regardless of this list.
